title: SegFormer: Simple and Efficient Design for Semantic Segmentation with Transformers
mechanism: Hierarchical Mix Transformer encoder without positional encoding plus a lightweight all-MLP decoder.
evidence: R: B4 50.3 mIoU ADE20K at 64M params; B5 84.0 Cityscapes val. On EL (D01, doi:10.1109/jphotov.2024.3450009) beat U-Net/DeepLab on UCF-EL.
adaptation: MiT-B2/B5 ADE20K weights, grey replicated, 1024 px or full-res skip since output is 1/4 res; lower encoder lr; mainly a benchmark entry and heterogeneous-ensemble member.
min_experiment: Arm MiT-B2 + full-res skip, 5-fold CV; baseline house; metrics mIoU_rob, crack relF1@2, E1 crack recall; kill if all three below house.
prior_overlap: none; transformers never tried. Same arm already proposed by D01; run once.

alt_notes.adaptation: MiT-B2/B5 ADE20K weights, 1-ch replicated, 1024 px input or a full-res skip; main candidate for the heterogeneous ensemble member; benchmark entry.
alt_notes.min_experiment: SegFormer-B2 1024 px alone vs house (5-fold) and as ensemble member vs house 5-seed ensemble; metrics as in the ensemble experiment; kill alone if mIoU_rob < 0.570, as member if no metric beats noise floor.
